text:
maya: dropped new frames — debating where invoice CTAs live in the spend table. full row vs compact icon vs slide-out. link: https://figma.com/file/abc

jorge: I vote compact icon + slide-out. preserves density but keeps download discoverable.

erin: Compact icon feels sneaky for some users; support logs show people search for 'invoice' a lot. maybe hybrid: small visible icon + consolidated header CTA for org scope.

sam: hybrid seems pragmatic. per-month icon (muted) + header primary 'Download all invoices' when scope=org.

maya: accessibility note: download icon must have aria-label e.g. aria-label="Download March 2026 invoice (PDF)" and be keyboard-focusable.

a11y-bot: Contrast report: sparklines need updated colors in dark mode. axis ticks fail at 12px; recommend 13px + #BFCBE0.

jorge: microcopy: change column header from 'Tokens' to 'Compute tokens (est.)' and add a short helper: 'Estimate based on usage; final billed amount may differ.'

erin: agree. show $ estimates only in slide-out or CSV export, not in compact table.

sam: dev note: include invoiceDownloadUrl in table row payload so the icon triggers a direct download without extra fetch. sample: {"invoiceDownloadUrl":"/invoices/2026-03-org.pdf","tokens":12345}

maya: keyboard flow: header scope chip -> date -> search -> table -> row download icon -> row details -> esc closes -> focus returns to icon. sam, can you mock this?

sam: will mock and test with NVDA. also make mobile hit targets >=44px.

a11y-bot: created ticket #5340: 'Spend table: invoice affordance + a11y fixes' with checklist [ARIA labels, popover focus, contrast, tab order, API field].

maya: action items: prototype hybrid frames, move scope chip next to date and persist in URL, update microcopy, implement invoiceDownloadUrl, apply contrast fixes. sync Thursday.
